# Lovebite — Escorts & Call Girls Directory in India

> Official directory of independent escorts, call girls and companions across India.

## About
Lovebite (https://www.lovebite.live) is a curated directory of verified independent companions in India. Profiles are self-published with real photos, published rates, and direct WhatsApp / phone contact.
